title: Route each viewer panel to an independent scheduler destination with retained GPU presentation
base_note: Cut from the pushed #62 still/sequence decode commit (the previous session head), not origin/main (36300a2), because the media-role viewer consumes that decode path.

source.production: apps/nemo-ui (ViewerRuntime, ViewerController, ViewerControllerRegistry, ViewerItem, main.cpp, qml/ViewerPanel.qml), src/nemo/eval (ViewerScheduler, Viewer, ViewerDestination), src/nemo/gpu (ViewerPresentation + viewerPresentation.slang), tests/*
source.prototype_reference: docs/evidence/assets/issue25-prototype-reference-v1.tar.gz: ViewerPanel.qml / FrameRuler.qml / TransportButton.qml (transport glyphs, in/out brackets, edit-in-place timecode, marked-range loop, layer/channel menus, 380px narrow layout)

implementation.destination_lifecycle: ViewerRuntime::allocateDestination(panelId)/retireDestination(destination); ids >= 2, bounded by kMaxViewerDestinations; the same panel reuses its id; exhaustion leaves the controller a facade with hasDestination=false and never aliases another panel.
implementation.scheduler: ViewerScheduler::cancel(id, destination), retireDestination(destination), counts(destination) added; per-destination cancel floor/token stored in DestinationState; global cancel(id)/counts() semantics unchanged.
implementation.runtime: submit(document,request,id,destination,channel), probe(...,destination), cancel(id,destination), counts(destination), per-destination channel, idempotent attachToWindow(window), one shared WindowPresentationState, framePresented(destination, frame, width, height, cacheHit, requestToSwapMs). Worker-side retire queue forwards ViewerSession::retireDestination.
implementation.controller: setDestination/hasDestination/destinationId; every probe/submit/takeResult/cancel/range routed to the panel destination; per-destination framePresented relay; presentationState delegates to the shared window host; transport (play/pause/stop/step/seek/marks/loop), timecode, channel/layer, and setViewerContext(role,target,clock) with real media-role source-node resolution and explicit unavailable states.
implementation.panel: ViewerPanel.qml binds viewerControllers.controller(panelId), releases on destruction, forwards panel context, and wires the prototype transport/display controls at the accepted compact geometry.
implementation.channel_isolation: gpu::ViewerChannel (RGBA/R/G/B/A) applied in the presentation compute copy via a set-0 binding-2 uniform buffer; evaluation and viewer-cache identity are unchanged.

verification.debug_ctest: 100% tests passed, 0 failed out of 392 (ctest --preset debug)
verification.release_ctest: 100% tests passed, 0 failed out of 392 (ctest --preset release)
verification.asan_focused: 9/9 passed under the asan preset: Viewer.PresentationIsolatesDisplayChannels, Interactive.SupersedingOneViewerPreservesOtherDestinationAndSnapshot, CancellationRejectsInflightAndSupersededBacklogIsCounted, CancelledSubmissionRetainsResourcesUntilActualGpuCompletion, DestinationScopedCancelDropsOnlyThatDestinationsWork, RetireDestinationDropsQueuedWorkAndRejectsInflight, CountsAreScopedPerDestinationAndGlobalStillAggregates, MediaFreeViewerRendersAttachedComposite, TwoViewerDestinationsRenderIndependentlyAndSurviveRetirement
new_tests: Interactive.TwoViewerDestinationsRenderIndependentlyAndSurviveRetirement (real GPU): two controllers with distinct allocated destinations render different targets concurrently; rapid supersession on A leaves B's presentation untouched; retiring A's destination leaves B's presentation and B's subsequent render intact

Interactive.ViewerControllerRegistryAllocatesIndependentDestinations: distinct controllers/destinations per panel id, reserved streams never allocated, primary ordering, release leaves the peer live and makes the released controller inert
Viewer.PresentationIsolatesDisplayChannels (real GPU): R/G/B/A isolation plus byte-identical RGBA premultiplied output
verification.builds: cmake --build --preset debug and --preset release clean apart from the pre-existing third-party minizip 'mktemp' linker warning

commands: QT_QPA_PLATFORM=wayland OCIO=docs/evidence/issue12-view.ocio build/debug/apps/nemo-ui/nemo-ui --source docs/evidence/assets/issue62-still-source/native-still-png.png (two-viewer workspace: split horizontal, panel-1 viewer group A, panel-2 viewer group B)
native_smoke.result: The application starts on Wayland with a two-viewer workspace and the still source, creates its window, and stays alive with no QML or GPU errors on stderr. The promoted initial-frame path now presents (previously failed synchronously before Qt.callLater created the panel controllers). The benchmark ran against the primary panel's destination and emitted a real {"event":"viewer_frame_swapped",...} sample before stopping on the expected still-image frame-count limit (frameCount == 1).
native_smoke.capture_limitation: Native pixel capture and pointer interaction are not possible in this environment: no compositor screenshot client (grim/slurp/import/scrot/maim) is installed and x11grab of the rootless Xwayland root returns a uniform black frame (verified). This run is a startup/CLI-wiring non-crash check only; it is NOT appearance or interaction-parity evidence. Owner native review of the two-viewer layout, transport controls, marked-range brackets, timecode entry, channel/layer menus, and the narrow 380px layout remains required.
native_smoke.per_destination_native_record: Not produced. Acceptance example 5's per-destination request id/frame/output/region/resolution/cache-hit/current-outdated native record requires the same interaction harness the prior issue:13 evidence used; the automated registry + GPU two-destination tests are the functional evidence for this ticket.

acceptance_examples.1_two_panels_independent: Covered by Interactive.TwoViewerDestinationsRenderIndependentlyAndSurviveRetirement (distinct outputs per destination, B untouched by A's activity) and Interactive.ViewerControllerRegistryAllocatesIndependentDestinations (distinct destinations, release isolation).
acceptance_examples.2_stale_rejection_per_destination: Covered by Interactive.DestinationScopedCancelDropsOnlyThatDestinationsWork + Interactive.SupersedingOneViewerPreservesOtherDestinationAndSnapshot (scheduler) and the rapid-supersession leg of the two-viewer test (only the newest request for the edited destination publishes).
acceptance_examples.3_cached_replay_identity: Existing Interactive.SharedCacheIdentitySurvivesPublicationFromTwoDestinations + ViewerCache.* unchanged; destination tag now reaches submit for panel work.
acceptance_examples.4_retained_lifetimes: Existing retained-ownership path unchanged (ASan run covers retire/cancel/teardown); Interactive.CancelledSubmissionRetainsResourcesUntilActualGpuCompletion and the new retirement tests pass under ASan.
acceptance_examples.5_native_per_destination_report: NOT met natively (capture/harness unavailable); functional coverage via the automated tests above.
acceptance_examples.6_context_apis_explicit_unavailable: ViewerPanel forwards PanelContextRouter role/group through setViewerContext; media role resolves a root-network source node or reports an explicit unavailable state; timeline role reports the #54 deferral; PanelContextRouter/PanelContextUi tests unchanged.
acceptance_examples.7_transport_and_channels: Play/pause/stop/step/seek/marks/loop/timecode/channel/resolution wired to the panel destination in ViewerPanel.qml; channel isolation proven by Viewer.PresentationIsolatesDisplayChannels. Depth layer is reported unavailable (no runtime implementation), not fabricated.

remaining_gates: Owner review for the new public surfaces: ViewerControllerRegistry, ViewerRuntime destination API, gpu::ViewerChannel, ViewerScheduler destination-scoped cancel/retire/counts.
Native appearance/interaction parity review with matched viewport/DPR (capture tooling unavailable here).
Per-destination native interaction record for acceptance example 5.
Media-role concurrent different-source native evidence needs the Media Bin import/UI (#43), which this ticket gates; the media role currently resolves graph source nodes.
Editorial timeline rendering remains #54 (explicit unavailable state here).
Depth layer and non-RGBA channel availability are reported, not fabricated.
